project.name: ciba-approval-service
project.description: Standalone Spring Boot app that plays the role of Keycloak's CIBA "Authentication Device" / Authentication Channel Provider endpoint. Receives Keycloak's server-to-server notification when a CIBA auth request is initiated, holds it in memory, and serves a simple poll-and-approve HTML page a human opens in a separate browser tab. Approving calls back to Keycloak's CIBA callback endpoint with the bearer token Keycloak supplied in the original notification. Deliberately standalone from keycloak-jpa-demo: different lifecycle (must be running BEFORE Keycloak is restarted with the auth-channel URI flag), different concern (an external identity-approval device simulator, not part of the JPA/training app).
